vetSays.line: A man, maybe 50s, with a burn-scarred forearm heads out for water. "Water first. Everything else waits." The pantry won't fill itself.
💧 A man, maybe 50s, with a burn-scarred forearm returns with water: +4 clean.
📓 Journal: the man in his 50s, with a burn-scarred forearm taught the man in his 50s, with ink-stained fingers Animal Behavior.
A man, maybe 50s, with a burn-scarred forearm hesitates, then backs off. "Not today. Sorry." (Low trust — reluctant.)
👂 Overheard — A man, maybe 50s, with a burn-scarred forearm: "Right. Let's do it, then. Talking doesn't chop wood."
"Can we talk?" A man, maybe 50s, with a burn-scarred forearm sighs. "I need some space. A corner nobody needs me in. Is that okay?" (Talk to A man, maybe 50s, with a burn-scarred forearm.)
👂 Overheard — A man, maybe 50s, with a burn-scarred forearm: "Okay — what's the first step?"
📋 A man, maybe 50s, with a burn-scarred forearm — 🪾 Gather deadfall. They'll report back by next part.
🍂 A man, maybe 50s, with a burn-scarred forearm gathers deadfall — 1 stick + 1 fiber. The pile grows. (1 sticks now.)
A man, maybe 50s, with a burn-scarred forearm heads out for water. "The well won't fill itself." Better close to the fire today.
You catch fragments by the fire — A man, maybe 50s, with a burn-scarred forearm telling A woman, maybe 40s, with sun-creased eyes about you. It's barely the same story now. That's what fires do.
💧 A man, maybe 50s, with a burn-scarred forearm returns with water: +3 clean.
A man, maybe 50s, with a burn-scarred forearm heads out for water. "Fetching water. Somebody has to." The pantry won't fill itself.
You lay out the haul. A man, maybe 50s, with a burn-scarred forearm leans over White Oak Acorns. "Oh — THAT one. Here, look."
📖 A man, maybe 50s, with a burn-scarred forearm starts in on the lesson, then catches themself. "Hold on — I already showed you this one. White Oak Acorns. You remember."
💧 A man, maybe 50s, with a burn-scarred forearm returns with water: +2 clean.
A man, maybe 50s, with a burn-scarred forearm heads out for water. "The well won't fill itself." The pantry won't fill itself.

A man, maybe 50s, with a burn-scarred forearm heads out for water. "Off to the well — back with a full skin." The pantry won't fill itself.

You catch fragments by the fire — A man, maybe 60s telling A man, maybe 50s, with a burn-scarred forearm about Rosa. Three retellings in, nobody remembers what actually happened — but everyone has opinions.
A woman, maybe 20s, with a missing fingertip sets out to find A man, maybe 50s, with a burn-scarred forearm. "Won't be long." Company makes the road shorter.

🚶 Zoe is back — found A man, maybe 50s, with a burn-scarred forearm.

You catch fragments by the fire — Kenneth telling A man, maybe 50s, with a burn-scarred forearm about A woman, maybe 40s, with sun-creased eyes. The truth left this story two fires ago. What's left is better theater.
💧 A man, maybe 50s, with a burn-scarred forearm returns with water: +2 clean.
🗣️ A man, maybe 50s, with a burn-scarred forearm to a woman, maybe 40s, with sun-creased eyes, by the fire: "Stone. We need 56 more for the palisade footings. Creek beds, hillsides — pry it loose."
🛡️ Kenneth, Rosa, Kebede and Adrianna met them at the door — 4 put down. Kenneth, Rosa, Kebede, Adrianna are hurt.
🛡️ Meera, Rosa and Kebede met them at the door — 2 put down, 1 driven off. Rosa, Kebede are hurt.
📓 Codex: you've heard of Cold-Blooded. Someone, somewhere, can do this. Now you know its name.
◈ THE SYSTEM has been watching Kebede — Craft 1. Three offers; they took Cold-Blooded. Earned, chosen. (cold_blooded: villager level-up)
📓 Codex: Kebede chose Cold-Blooded (cold_blooded) at Craft 1.

📺 "Oh, you survived the AUDIENCE NOTES? Cute. We've stopped pretending these are animals now. That was the FINAL DRAFT, folks — what comes out of the treeline next was never alive the way you mean it."
📺 SYSTEM: "Oh — OH. Everybody saw that, right? Aki just put down The Terms of Service... on CAMERA. That's a veteran kill, folks. REMEMBER the name."
🛡️ Meera, Kebede, Adrianna and Aki met them at the door — 4 put down. Meera, Kebede, Adrianna, Aki are hurt.
📺 "We've been watching you for a LONG time. Your faiths. Your formats. Your little institutions. So we built something out of... well. Out of YOU. Say hello to the MIRROR DRAFT."
⚠ This one is different — scarred, braced, waiting for your opening. A Scarred veteran.
It saw the opening coming — braced, scar tissue white. Your first strike glances off. (SCARRED: -3 first strike)
The Scarred Choir Toad falls.
📺 +20 style — dropped the Scarred Choir Toad!

◈ SYSTEM: "Four waves. FOUR. The producers are — okay, I'm saying it: FINALES need a NATION. You've got a region; now make it a REALM. Bind fires under one head, or bend the knee to someone who has. The higher-ups are watching. ...Did I say higher-ups? I said NOTHING. Forget the higher-ups."

◈ ARC IV — THE INEFFICIENCY. SYSTEM: "ROUNDING ERROR RECLASSIFIED: ANOMALY. Organic consumption yields impossible output. Recalculating. Recalculating." — They finally see it. The thing they laughed at — needing to EAT — is the engine. Their confusion is your weapon now. You stood up to the calibration fauna, the audience's notes, the Final Draft — lived through their Show, weathered the worst together, and built something bigger than a village. One day humanity will need a case to make. The case is made of deeds, not words — and yours, though unfinished, are undeniable. (Feasted buffs burn ho
📺 "But finales — FINALES need a LEGEND, sweetheart. More STANDING — blood, bonds, or bread — and look the Mirror Draft in the eye. The producers are WAITING."
★ IDENTIFIED: Ground Elder. Creeping patches of divided leaves in shady spots. Uses unknown — harvest, taste, and learn.
📚 Village knowledge: Ava taught everyone about Ground Elder. The Codex grows without you lifting a finger.
Ava drew Ground Elder in the dirt for the others. It'll wash away. The knowledge won't.
The fire burns low. One new line in the journal: Ground Elder — named and noted.
